test_title: PYST 22: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 13 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Ashish has two grandsons Ketan and Mahesh. 15 year old Ketan gets some money from Ashish’s wealth and 16 year old Mahesh gets rest of the money. But Ketan and Mahesh will get money only when they turn 23 years old. Till then the money is in a bank getting interest at rate 4% compounded annually. When both turn 23, they receive the same amount. How much had Ashish given Mahesh (in ₹) initially, if total money with Ashish was ₹25500?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When amounts are equal at CI, ratio of principal shares P₂ / P₁ = (1 + R / 100)t¹ − t²

Time for Ketan = 23 − 15 = 8 years | Time for Mahesh = 23 − 16 = 7 years

Ratio Mahesh : Ketan = (1 + 4/100)⁸ − ⁷ = 104 / 100 = 26 / 25

Total parts = 26 + 25 = 51 parts ⇒ ₹25500

Mahesh's share = 26 parts = 26 × (25500 ÷ 51) = ₹13000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹13000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total money distributed = ₹25500

Age of Ketan = 15 years, Age of Mahesh = 16 years

Target age for receiving money = 23 years

Rate of interest (R) = 4% compounded annually

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest Amount, A = P(1 + R/100)t
